$comment: Which revision of each upstream contract this assembly line derives from.
A pin, not a copy. The definitions live with whoever owns the concept —
zone-id belongs to nexus-vfs, because zone is its kernel concept and
create_zone is there. Copying the spec here would make a second truth and it
would start drifting the same day. Naming a revision does not.
This must name the same nexus-vfs revision the shipped daemon was built
from. A validator that disagrees with the daemon it is validating for is
worse than no validator: it would reject ids the daemon accepts, or pass ids
it refuses, and either way the operator is told something false.
